title: 恒星間漂流における静止した因果
author: 霧島 慧

en.title: Static Causality in Interstellar Drift
en.premise: When a failed faster‑than‑light jump warps time around the star‑hopping fleet Elysion, the ship’s Recorder discovers a nameless corpse and a broken pocket watch whose hands have stopped yet faintly radiate heat, defying physics. The watch is the sole piece of evidence of a “temporal discontinuity” that could tear the fleet apart. Using cold, logical deduction, the Recorder uncovers the fatal miscalculation hidden behind the fleet’s deceptive calm.

zh.title: 恒星间漂流中的静止因果
zh.premise: 一次超光速航行的失敗使星际漂流舰队「エリュシオン」的时间局部扭曲。船上的記錄官在「祭りの夜」发现了一具身份不明的遗体与一只指针停止、却微微发热、违背物理定律的坏怀表。此表是证明将导致舰队崩坏的「时间不连续性」的唯一实物证据。記錄官以严密的推理，揭露了伪装的宁静背后致命的计算错误。
